title: A3: mimid-agent daemon: 127.0.0.1 HTTP JMAP, bearer token in a 0600 file, EventSource
description: Binary crates/mimid-agent over A1+A2: config (server URL, user, server token file, state dir), listens on 127.0.0.1 only (refuse other addresses), generates a per-user bearer token into a 0600 file on first start, serves the JMAP Session/API/EventSource from crate-jmap-server. Logs per mimid's logging rules. Decision mimid-1wgh.13 note 2026-11-16.
close_reason: Merged (crates/mimid-agent, 0889f16): loopback-only daemon, 0600 local token, Host check, CORS allowlist, Session/API/EventSource over A2, sync loop, graceful shutdown. Also fixed: A1 consent futures and A2 sync future made Send. 1447 workspace tests at the pre-merge run; clippy clean.
